name: comp-72
title: Textarea Animated Label
blurb: Label animates upward and shrinks when the field is focused or filled.
description: A textarea with a label that smoothly transitions from inside the field to above it on focus or when text is entered, using CSS :has() and :focus-within selectors.
use_when: You need a modern floating-label pattern with smooth animations triggered by user interaction.
avoid_when: On projects requiring prefers-reduced-motion compliance or minimal JavaScript overhead.
a11y: Label connected via htmlFor, relies on CSS pseudo-classes for state detection, respects aria-invalid styling.
